column3: “when the judges governed” renders “of the judging of the judges”; “the land of Moab” renders “the fields of Moab” (also in verses 2, 6, and 22).
“that she might return” renders “and she returned.”
“grant that you may find rest” renders “give to you, and find rest”; “voices” renders the Hebrew singular “voice.”
“refrain from marrying” renders “shut yourselves off from having a husband”; “it is harder for me than for you” renders “it is very bitter to me, more than you.”
“and worse” renders “and thus may He add”; “if anything but death parts you and me” renders “if death separates me and you.”
“said no more to her” renders “ceased to speak to her.”
“was stirred” renders “was excited”; “the women said” renders the feminine plural “they said.”
“Naomi” means “pleasant” and “Mara” means “bitter”; “dealt very bitterly with me” renders “caused me great bitterness.”
